shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin surpassed $80,000, driven by 10-month high institutional ETF inflows and a broad rally.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reached 74 (Greed), reflecting generally bullish social media sentiment.
US Treasury bond buybacks led to dollar selling, creating a favorable environment for Bitcoin and gold.
Geopolitical risks, especially between the US and Iran, contributed to overall market uncertainty.
Term Finance suffered an $8.5 million governance exploit, raising concerns about DeFi security.
